prompt: A lone hooded lantern bearer seen from behind stands in a narrow fog-bound cobbled alley of an 1890s harbor town at night, holding a brass lantern whose warm amber glow is the only light. Far down the alley a veiled bride in a grey gown stands half lost in the fog, facing the bearer. Wet cobblestones reflect the lantern glow and tall black brick walls with dark shuttered windows close in on both sides. Realistic dark Victorian oil painting with soft painterly brushwork, deep blue-black shadows and smooth blended shading. Portrait composition with plain empty fog in the upper third. Every wall and surface is blank and plain.
